reference_sql:
SELECT product_id, sku, length(sku) AS n_chars
FROM products
WHERE sku <> UPPER(sku)
alternatives: SELECT product_id, sku, length(sku) AS n_chars FROM products WHERE sku LIKE 'vm%'
SELECT product_id, sku, length(sku) AS n_chars FROM products WHERE NOT (sku = UPPER(sku))

other_way.sql: SELECT product_id, sku, length(sku) AS n_chars FROM products WHERE sku LIKE 'vm%'
other_way.tradeoff: LIKE 'vm%' works only because every lower-case sku here starts with vm, while comparing with UPPER(sku) finds one anywhere.

planted_wrong.sql: SELECT product_id, sku, length(sku) AS n_chars FROM products WHERE sku = LOWER(TRIM(sku))
SELECT product_id, sku, length(sku) AS n_chars FROM products WHERE sku <> TRIM(sku)
